GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 620 (27 Jan 50) CE
(SCAPIN-2076/2)
APO 500
18 July 1950
MEMORANDUM FOR : Japanese Government.
SUBJECT : Provision of Additional Dependent Housing for the Occupation Forces.
1. Reference: Memorandum, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied powers, AG 628(27 Jan 50)ESS/PF SCAPIN 2076, subject: Provision of Additional Dependent Housing for Occupation Forces, 27 January 1950, aa amended by SCAPIN 2076/1, 4 July 1950.
2. That portion of SCAPIN 2076 referenced above that pertains to the construction of 2000 units is amended herewith to provide 2001 units.
3. This additional unit will be located at the Koshiba Petroleum Terminal and will be completed by 15 November 1950.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General
